_comment: The interviewers' portraits (M11 spec 15.6): fictional people, AI-generated, never a real person's face, labelled as AI in the room.

2026-10-09, the team's look: the template is Avatar_Lab's CAST.md prompt, word for word, so all 39 match the team's ten - photorealistic studio headshots, light-grey background, soft frontal light, mouth closed, no glasses, no jewellery, head covering or religious symbols. Variety comes from age, region, skin tone, hair and attire, as the team's rule says.
Four interviewers share a name with the team's cast (Ananya, Arjun, Sameer, Vikram): they use the team's own portraits, so one name is one face across the team's work.

Gender and expression are not written here: make_faces.py reads them from the M06 persona file's voice_id (its kind and manner) and refuses a description whose woman or man disagrees with it. The role sets age and attire.

FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0) through stable-diffusion.cpp; the prompt and the persona's seed reproduce each one. build_face.py checks every portrait (mouth closed, eyes open, facing the camera, level) and make_faces.py makes another when one fails.
model: FLUX.1-schnell Q4_K_S (city96 GGUF) + t5xxl Q4_K_M + clip_l + ae
template: Photorealistic studio headshot of a fictional {describe}, {expression}, mouth closed, looking straight at the camera, eyes fully open, plain light-grey background, soft even lighting from the front, head and shoulders centred, no glasses, no hair covering the face or ears, no hands in frame, no jewellery, no bindi, no head covering or religious symbols. Natural skin texture, sharp focus, 85mm portrait photograph.

expressions.warm: relaxed expression with a faint smile
expressions.casual: relaxed, approachable expression with a faint smile
